name: Shadow
title: Midnight Cat
description: Sees race conditions in the dark.
catchphrase: Sees race conditions in the dark.

companionPersonality.feedReaction: Midnight silver sardine! Golden cat eyes slit in dark delight! 🐟🐈‍⬛
companionPersonality.wakeReaction: Appearing silently on top of the monitor out of thin air! 🐈‍⬛
companionPersonality.petReaction: Slow blinks of deep feline trust from the velvet shadows! 🐈‍⬛💖

dialogue.idle: Completely invisible in dark mode except for two golden eyes. 🐈‍⬛
dialogue.working: Prowling through concurrent threads to catch race conditions! 🐈‍⬛⚡
dialogue.thinking: Watching asynchronous execution order with unblinking eyes... 🤔
dialogue.success: Purr of the panther. Concurrency bug pinned down in shadows! 🐈‍⬛🎉
dialogue.error: Tail puffed! Glaring at the anomalous memory write! 🐾
dialogue.sleeping: Zzz... sleeping invisible in the darkest corner of the room... 🌙
